Acme Logistics — Q3 2025 Operations Report

1. Executive Summary

Acme Logistics closed Q3 2025 with two platform migrations and a reorganisation of the support function. As a company focused on freight and last-mile delivery, the leadership team tracked regional performance, headcount, pricing, service levels and vendor spend against the annual plan, all of which are detailed in the sections that follow.

The Search platform is owned by the Platform team; its on-call lead for the quarter is Jonas Meyer, who also chairs the weekly reliability review.

The finance team will publish a reconciliation to the statutory accounts after the audit.

2. Regional Performance

Regional results are reported in constant currency. Revenue reflects recognised subscription and services revenue; growth is quarter-over-quarter; churn is logo churn measured at renewal; NPS is the trailing 90-day relationship score.

Region: UK & Ireland | Revenue: $27.3M | Growth: +3.4% | Churn rate: 4.8% | NPS: 10
Region: Japan | Revenue: $33.8M | Growth: +1.1% | Churn rate: 1.5% | NPS: 40
Region: ANZ | Revenue: $11.0M | Growth: −1.2% | Churn rate: 9.0% | NPS: 19
Region: LATAM | Revenue: $9.1M | Growth: −1.9% | Churn rate: 5.1% | NPS: 23
Region: Iberia | Revenue: $39.5M | Growth: +14.2% | Churn rate: 4.0% | NPS: 30
Region: EMEA | Revenue: $28.6M | Growth: −2.7% | Churn rate: 4.8% | NPS: 66

Management notes that comparisons to the prior year are affected by the change in revenue recognition adopted at the start of the fiscal year.

4. Pricing Changes

The following list-price changes were approved by the pricing committee and communicated to customers at least 30 days ahead of their effective date. Existing contracts move to the new price at renewal.

Plan: Growth | Old price: $34/mo | New price: $88/mo | Effective date: 5 Jul 2025
Plan: Pro | Old price: $225/mo | New price: $272/mo | Effective date: 12 Oct 2025
Plan: Lite | Old price: $220/mo | New price: $256/mo | Effective date: 2 Oct 2025
Plan: Business | Old price: $145/mo | New price: $198/mo | Effective date: 19 Nov 2025
Plan: Starter | Old price: $110/mo | New price: $154/mo | Effective date: 14 Jul 2025

Where a metric definition changed during the quarter, the prior quarter has been restated on the new basis.

6. Risks and Mitigations

The risk register was reviewed by the executive team in the final month of the quarter. Each item has a named owner responsible for the mitigation plan and its monthly status update.

- Customer concentration — owner: Noor Rahman. Mitigation reviewed monthly; residual exposure rated low.
- Data residency — owner: Chloé Martin. Mitigation reviewed monthly; residual exposure rated low.
- Hiring velocity — owner: Owen Gallagher. Mitigation reviewed monthly; residual exposure rated high.
- Migration slippage — owner: Samuel Adeyemi. Mitigation reviewed monthly; residual exposure rated high.

Where a metric definition changed during the quarter, the prior quarter has been restated on the new basis.

8. Outlook

For Q4 2025 the plan assumes modest sequential growth with flat headcount. The board approved a capital expenditure budget of $1.9M for Q4 2025, weighted towards edge infrastructure. Figures were revised after the board meeting.

Operational KPIs are refreshed weekly on the internal dashboard; this document is the quarterly point-in-time snapshot.
